newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: PETER BRUCE NAMED S.AFRICA FINANCIAL MAIL EDITOR.
newsitem.headline: PETER BRUCE NAMED S.AFRICA FINANCIAL MAIL EDITOR.

text.p: South African publishing group Times Media Ltd , fresh from striking a deal with Britain's Pearson Plc , said on Monday that it had appointed Peter Bruce as the new editor of its Financial Mail magazine.

Bruce, who has held various editorial posts on Pearson's Financial Times flagship business paper, was last editor of South Africa's Business Report, part of the Independent Newspapers Holdings Ltd stable.
Bruce, who was born in South Africa's Transkei region, replaces Nigel Bruce, who resigned as Financial Mail editor last month.
Earlier on Monday Pearson announced it had bought a 50 percent stake in TML's Business Day and Financial Mail publications for 87.5 million rand.
The announcement followed months of speculation that Pearson had been stalking the South African publications.
Business Day has daily sales of 40,200 and the weekly Financial Mail sales of 31,100.

Also included in the deal is television production company, African Business Channel (ABC), which currently produces a nightly business news programme on South African national television. ABC is already a 50/50 partnership between TML and FT Television.
Pearson said a new company called African Business Media Ltd will be formed to house the various interests.
